rows.text:
A long list, recording the "names" you once encountered or heard of in Amphoreus.
They are not merely data from the countless simulations of Scepter δ-me13, drawn from the simulated world of Amphoreus. Because of your arrival, they changed their fates, lived as though real, and remain as memories etched in your mind.
